title: Components: inside the workspace server, the control plane and the data service of diagram 02; the components the cards name and the stores each touches
arrows: synchronous calls; protocol and credential in brackets

nodes.label: Browser workspace
nodes.desc: The canvas island, the renderer library, forms, the composer chat

nodes.label: Session adapter
nodes.desc: Verifies fAuth's EdDSA token against the cached key set; mints and reads the platform session

nodes.label: Authorizer
nodes.desc: Permission by role against the membership row and its epoch, on every request; denies as 404

nodes.label: View server
nodes.desc: Pages and the canvas from typed props; forwards typed queries and record commands with the principal and epoch

nodes.label: Navigator
nodes.desc: Click and alias to one stable id; retrieval over the organization's index file, re-checked for authorization

nodes.label: Draft editor
nodes.desc: Patches on a base revision with semantic diff; synthetic previews; the isolated preview store; forwards admission and publication

nodes.label: Work keeper
nodes.desc: Saved work, bindings, personal state, share grants; adoption by compare-and-set

nodes.label: Admission
nodes.desc: Schema, grammar, complexity, renderer and operator versions; a digest per admitted revision

nodes.label: Publisher
nodes.desc: Policy, approval over the digest, the publication record, the adoption table, the governance audit

nodes.label: Query engine
nodes.desc: Typed operations over Parquet revisions and a record snapshot; receipts, budgets, exports

nodes.label: Record store
nodes.desc: Record commands: idempotency outcome, expected version, membership epoch, record revision, outcome and audit in one transaction

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.tech: RDS Multi-AZ; row-level security per organization
nodes.desc: Sessions, membership, drafts, saved work, publications, policy, records, outcomes, audit

nodes.label: Key management
nodes.tech: AWS KMS, one data key per organization
nodes.desc: Unwraps the data key a revision was encrypted under

edges.label: sign-in callback; every request [HTTPS, session cookie]
membership row and epoch [TLS, role workspace]
submit, approve over the digest, publish [HTTP, service identity]
drafts, patches, preview records [TLS, role workspace]
saved work, bindings, personal state; adoption compare-and-set [TLS, role workspace]
typed queries with principal and epoch [HTTP, service identity]
record commands with key and expected version [HTTP, service identity]
publications, policy, adoption table, audit [TLS, role control]
one transaction: record, outcome, audit [TLS, role data]

boundaries.label: Workspace server: role workspace; the one authorization point
Control plane: role control; the only writer of publications and policy
Data service: role data; the only reader of Parquet and writer of records
